FINAL OWNER DIRECTIVE — REMOVE RORK 100% FROM IVX

I do not want Rork required for:

- Source code
- Development
- Build
- CI/CD
- AI
- Authentication
- Deployment
- Runtime
- Mobile signing
- Assets
- Monitoring
- Autonomous development

TARGET

RORK ACTIVE DEPENDENCY = 0%

IVX must continue operating after Rork access is removed.

Do not preserve a Rork dependency for convenience.

Do not delete working functionality without first creating and verifying an IVX-controlled replacement.

Execute in this exact order.

==================================================
1. FREEZE THE CURRENT WORKING RELEASE
==================================================

Record:

- Repository: ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- Branch: main
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- GitHub Actions run ID
- API deployment ID
- Worker deployment ID
- API live SHA
- Worker live SHA
- /health response
- /version response
- Current rollback SHA
- Database migration version
- UTC timestamp

Confirm:

- GitHub HEAD = API SHA = Worker SHA = /version SHA
- Website HTTP 200
- API /health HTTP 200
- Public chat HTTP 200
- Current rollback point exists

Do not continue if the baseline is unstable.

==================================================
2. ROTATE THE EXPOSED IOS TOOLKIT CREDENTIAL
==================================================

The audit found a toolkit credential in:

ios-ivx-holdings/.env

Immediately:

1. Identify the provider/account.
2. Revoke or rotate the exposed credential.
3. Do not display the value.
4. Confirm production does not require it.
5. Remove it from:
   - repository history where appropriate
   - current source tree
   - iOS environment files
   - Render
   - Expo/EAS
   - GitHub Actions secrets
6. Run a secret scan.

Return:

- Credential name
- Provider
- Rotation status
- Old credential revoked: YES / NO
- Active readers after removal
- Secret scan result

==================================================
3. REMOVE IOS RORK VARIABLES AND CONFIGURATION
==================================================

Remove all active Rork iOS configuration from:

- ios-ivx-holdings/.env
- IVXHoldings/Config.swift
- Info.plist
- build settings
- xcconfig files
- URL schemes
- associated domains
- build scripts
- Swift packages
- CocoaPods

Search for:

- RORK
- rork
- rork.com
- toolkit
- Rork endpoint
- Rork auth URL
- Rork functions URL
- Rork project ID

Replace with IVX-controlled configuration.

Required result:

- Active Rork iOS variables: 0
- Active Rork iOS URLs: 0
- Active Rork iOS SDKs: 0
- Active Rork build scripts: 0

==================================================
4. MIGRATE IOS IDENTITY TO IVX
==================================================

Replace any Rork-namespaced iOS identity.

Set an IVX-owned bundle identifier, for example:

com.ivxholdings.app

Use the final identifier already approved by the owner if one exists.

Update:

- Xcode project bundle IDs
- targets
- schemes
- entitlements
- provisioning
- signing team
- push notification identifiers
- associated domains
- keychain groups
- app groups
- deep links

Requirements:

- IVX-controlled Apple team
- IVX-controlled signing certificate
- IVX-controlled provisioning profile
- No Rork Apple team
- No Rork bundle identifier
- No Rork signing identity

No App Store submission required now.

==================================================
5. MIGRATE ANDROID NAMESPACE TO IVX
==================================================

Replace:

com.rork.ivxholdings

with an IVX-owned application ID, for example:

com.ivxholdings.app

Use the final application ID already approved by the owner if one exists.

Update:

- namespace
- applicationId
- package declarations
- Kotlin/Java directories
- imports
- AndroidManifest.xml
- intent filters
- deep links
- Firebase configuration if used
- Gradle configuration
- tests
- release scripts
- APK validation
- documentation used by CI

Replace:

Theme.RorkApp

with:

Theme.IVXHoldings

or the approved IVX theme name.

Requirements:

- No `com.rork.*` namespace
- No `Theme.RorkApp`
- No Rork deep link
- No Rork signing identity
- No Rork Maven registry
- No Rork SDK

==================================================
6. CREATE IVX-OWNED MOBILE SIGNING
==================================================

Android:

- Use IVX-controlled production keystore
- Protect keystore credentials
- Configure release signing
- Return certificate fingerprint only
- Do not expose passwords or private keys

iOS:

- Use IVX-controlled Apple signing
- Verify bundle ID
- Verify entitlements
- Verify provisioning

No store submission required.

==================================================
7. RECONCILE RENDER.YAML
==================================================

Update `render.yaml` so it references:

ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Remove:

- old repository names
- old Rork service references
- obsolete root paths
- obsolete environment groups
- Rork-specific build commands
- Rork-specific deploy hooks

Verify:

- API service definition
- worker service definition
- branch = main
- health path
- build command
- start command
- environment groups
- auto-deploy behavior

Do not create duplicate services.

==================================================
8. REMOVE RORK SYNC FROM THE REQUIRED WORKFLOW
==================================================

Audit and replace:

- expo/sync-github.mjs
- Rork sync layer
- sandbox-only repository sync
- Rork-controlled push flow

The required development flow must become:

IVX DEVELOPER OR IVX WORKER
→ STANDARD GIT COMMIT
→ STANDARD GITHUB PUSH
→ GITHUB ACTIONS
→ RENDER DEPLOYMENT
→ HEALTH CHECK

Rork sync must not be required.

It may remain temporarily only as unused historical tooling until the independent path passes.

==================================================
9. REPLACE EVERY RORK.JSON FUNCTION
==================================================

Map every function provided by `rork.json`.

For every function return:

- Function
- Current command
- Purpose
- IVX-owned replacement
- GitHub Actions step
- Test result

Create standard scripts in package.json or workspace manifests for:

- lint
- typecheck
- tests
- integration tests
- backend build
- worker build
- website build
- Expo validation
- Android validation
- iOS validation
- security scan
- secret scan
- dependency audit
- independence audit
- production smoke test

No required test or build may depend on `rork.json`.

==================================================
10. RUN CLEAN INDEPENDENT CI
==================================================

Run GitHub Actions using only:

- ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- GitHub Actions
- IVX-owned secrets
- public package registries
- approved providers

Required jobs:

- Backend tests
- Type checks
- Integration tests
- Security scan
- Secret scan
- Dependency audit
- Rork-independence guard
- Backend build
- Worker build
- Website build
- Expo validation
- Android release consistency
- iOS configuration validation

All mandatory jobs must be green.

==================================================
11. REMOVE RORK.JSON
==================================================

Only after the replacement CI passes:

1. Remove `rork.json`.
2. Remove references to `rork.json`.
3. Remove sandbox-only registration.
4. Preserve useful IVX-owned audit scripts.
5. Commit.
6. Push.
7. Run CI again.
8. Deploy.
9. Verify production.

Required result:

rork.json present: NO

==================================================
12. REMOVE ALL RORK ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES
==================================================

After proving active reader count = 0, remove every:

- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_*
- RORK_*
- Rork toolkit variable
- Rork endpoint variable
- Rork project variable
- Rork token
- Rork secret

Audit:

- Render API
- Render worker
- environment groups
- GitHub Actions
- Expo/EAS
- iOS
- Android
- Supabase functions
- local templates

Never show values.

Return for each variable:

- Name
- Location
- Reader count
- Removal result
- Restart required
- Verification

==================================================
13. VERIFY ZERO RORK PACKAGES AND SDKS
==================================================

Audit:

- package manifests
- lockfiles
- Gradle
- CocoaPods
- Swift packages
- Git dependencies
- private registries
- postinstall scripts
- build plugins

Required counts:

- Rork packages: 0
- Rork SDKs: 0
- Rork registries: 0
- Rork binary downloads: 0
- Rork postinstall calls: 0
- Rork Git dependencies: 0

Regenerate lockfiles.

==================================================
14. VERIFY ZERO RORK ASSETS AND NETWORK CALLS
==================================================

Search for:

- rork.com
- r2-pub.rork.com
- Rork CDN
- Rork asset URLs
- Rork WebSockets
- Rork telemetry
- Rork redirects
- Rork cookies

Verify traffic during:

- website startup
- owner login
- public chat
- owner dashboard
- member registration
- uploads
- reels
- worker heartbeat
- QA job
- deployment job
- Android startup
- iOS startup

Required result:

Rork-owned hostnames contacted: 0

==================================================
15. COMPLETE OWNER-CONTROLLED AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Rork must not be in the final deployment chain.

Required chain:

OWNER SIGNS INTO IVX
→ OWNER APPROVES EXACT SHA
→ IVX ISSUES SHORT-LIVED SINGLE-USE AUTHORIZATION
→ IVX WORKER AUTHENTICATES WITH HMAC
→ GITHUB ACTIONS RUNS
→ BUILD PASSES
→ RENDER DEPLOYS
→ /HEALTH PASSES
→ /VERSION MATCHES
→ PROOF LEDGER WRITTEN
→ REPLAY REJECTED

The owner must approve inside IVX.

Do not ask the owner to paste a Supabase access token into Rork chat.

Required evidence:

- Authorization ID
- Job ID
- Worker ID
- GitHub Actions run ID
- Approved SHA
- Executed SHA
- API deployment ID
- Worker deployment ID
- Proof ledger ID
- Replay rejection

==================================================
16. CLEAN-ROOM BUILD OUTSIDE RORK
==================================================

Use an IVX-controlled runner or GitHub Actions environment.

Conditions:

- Fresh clone
- No Rork login
- No Rork session
- No Rork API key
- No Rork SDK
- No Rork variables
- No rork.json
- No Rork sync
- No cached Rork package
- No Rork build service

Execute:

1. Install dependencies
2. Lint
3. Type check
4. Unit tests
5. Integration tests
6. Security scan
7. Secret scan
8. Build backend
9. Build worker
10. Build website
11. Validate Expo
12. Build Android APK
13. Validate iOS build
14. Start API
15. Start worker
16. Verify /health
17. Verify /version
18. Run one owner-approved QA job

==================================================
17. DEPLOY FINAL INDEPENDENT RELEASE
==================================================

Commit and push all migration changes.

Deploy the final approved SHA.

Return:

GITHUB
- Repository
- Branch
- HEAD SHA
- Actions run ID

API
- Service ID
- Deployment ID
- Live SHA
- /health
- /version

WORKER
- Service ID
- Deployment ID
- Live SHA
- Heartbeat
- Latest completed job

ANDROID
- Application ID
- Version
- Build ID
- APK
- SHA-256
- Signing fingerprint

IOS
- Bundle ID
- Build ID
- Signing owner
- Validation result

==================================================
18. FINAL ZERO-RORK MATRIX
==================================================

Return exact counts:

- Active Rork APIs:
- Active Rork SDKs:
- Active Rork packages:
- Active Rork variables:
- Active Rork domains:
- Active Rork runtime calls:
- Active Rork build dependencies:
- Active Rork CI dependencies:
- Active Rork deployment dependencies:
- Active Rork authentication dependencies:
- Active Rork telemetry:
- Active Rork webhooks:
- Active Rork assets:
- Rork-namespaced iOS identifiers:
- Rork-namespaced Android identifiers:
- rork.json:
- Rork sync required:

Every active count must be 0.

==================================================
FINAL PASS CONDITIONS
==================================================

Mark RORK REMOVAL = PASS only when:

- Rork active API calls = 0
- Rork SDKs = 0
- Rork packages = 0
- Rork variables = 0
- Rork domains contacted = 0
- Rork build dependency = 0
- Rork CI dependency = 0
- Rork deployment dependency = 0
- Rork authentication dependency = 0
- Rork telemetry = 0
- Rork webhooks = 0
- Rork assets = 0
- iOS Rork namespace = 0
- Android Rork namespace = 0
- rork.json removed
- Rork sync not required
- Clean-room build passes
- Android builds with IVX identity
- iOS validates with IVX identity
- Autonomous deployment completes without Rork
- Production regression passes
- Rollback remains available
- GitHub HEAD matches API, worker, and /version

FINAL STATUS

RORK REMOVAL:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

RORK ACTIVE DEPENDENCY:
0% / NOT YET 0%

IVX FULL INDEPENDENCE:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

Do not return another audit-only report.

Execute the migration phase by phase and provide evidence after each completed phase.
